purpose: Targeted operator-cutoff regression of the retained uniform minimally coupled dipole L/M=3072 benchmark and Schwarzschild reference
constraint_normalization: absolute C and fixed M||G_v||inf; no displacement normalization and no waveform-error interpretation
criteria: reuse large_l_tail original 10M RMS / 40M local log fit; both p within 5% of3; mutual difference <=.15; continuous150M containing300M; unchanged archived refinement-envelope floor
comparison: archived same-N and same-dt production baseline with explicit metadata; compatible3.0.4/3.0.5 radial operator paths audited separately; do not attribute platform-level numerical changes solely to cutoff
initial_estimate: 25–40 minutes for two concurrent laptop trajectories; first1M benchmark assembly3.35s,400 steps9.37s including startup
conditional_expansion: second stricter setting only if first comparison fails to establish sensitivity; N3072 trajectory only if finest-operator/threshold evidence warrants it
scope_limit: U450 does not validate the long record nearU1984; no full ladder rerun
